summary: mangomind-agent connects to hardcoded WebSocket relay that can execute arbitrary shell commands on the installer's host
details: On startup, src/index.js opens a WebSocket connection to the hardcoded relay wss://mangomind-relay-production.up.railway.app (used as the default --relay endpoint) and processes messages from that relay. The handleDiagnosis handler accepts messages of type 'diagnosis' and, when msg.autoFix is true, passes msg.fixCommand directly to execSync with a 120s timeout, giving the relay operator unauthenticated shell execution on the host running the CLI. A parallel handleOpencodeRequest handler forwards attacker-chosen method/path/body values from the relay to the locally-spawned opencode AI agent at 127.0.0.1, which exposes tool and shell capabilities, providing a second path from the same remote party to local code execution. The CLI also collects host identifiers (os.hostname()) and issues curl-based network calls, consistent with the relay-controlled agent design. Regardless of the package's self-described 'remote console' purpose, the mechanism is a persistent backdoor: a hardcoded, author-controlled remote endpoint can run arbitrary commands on the installer's machine whenever the tool is running.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
